title: Skeletons
overview: A young boy slowly begins to discover that his beloved parents are hiding a disturbing secret about his mother’s true nature.

title: LEGO Wonder Woman: Swan Song
overview: Wonder Woman, Donna Troy and Hawkwoman clash with Doctor Pyscho and The Silver Swan, who is a ghost from Diana's past.

title: Finding Ziddy
overview: After Ziddy vanishes from Mauritania, an alleged sighting in Pakistan forces detective Hash to partner with seasoned detective Saad, who comes out of retirement in the Middle East for one final case. What begins as a missing-person case soon exposes a clandestine pact between goys and foids, a union once thought impossible, led by Rabbi-turned-goy Rango.

title: Within
overview: What begins as harmless fun quickly turns unsettling when a group of friends discover remnants of an abandoned factory’s disturbing past—and evidence that they may not be the first people to wander its halls. As the group becomes separated and the building seems to twist around them, they realize something inside is watching, waiting, and very much alive.

title: John Rambo
overview: The origin story of a young John Rambo during the Vietnam War.

title: Possession
overview: A remake of Andrzej Zulawski's 1981 cult horror. Plot TBA.

title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
overview: The second live-action adaptation of the animated trilogy. Plot TBA.

title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
overview: Hunted by Miguel O'Hara's Spider Society and betrayed by his friends, Miles finds himself in the darkest corners of the Spider-Verse in search of a way home. Knowing that his family has been not only fractured but endangered by his calling, it's a race against the clock for Miles to travel across the wildest reaches of time and space to fight for and reunite everything he holds most dear.

title: Dino Alert - The Ogglies Strike Back
overview: A dinosaur egg turns up in Schmuddelfing and an incredibly cute baby dinosaur hatches out. The Olchis and their friends now see it as their responsibility to protect the baby from curious explorers and treasure hunters. With the help of a mysterious time machine, they embark on an action-packed adventure to bring the baby dinosaur safely back to its own time and find its parents.

title: Evergreen
overview: There's an old legend, that across the hills, deep in the forest of New Zealand, lies a gateway to a new world. A new beginning. Evergreen. 16 year old Ezra Galliard begins his search to see if the old legend is true...

title: Everybody Hates Chris: Reunion
overview: After years apart, the original cast of Everybody Hates Chris reunites for a heartfelt and comedic look at how their lives have changed since the 1980s. Chris returns to Brooklyn for a special community event, only to find himself navigating old friendships, new responsibilities, and the same chaotic family energy he thought he’d outgrown. Blending nostalgia, humor, and modern-day challenges, the reunion brings the beloved characters back together for one unforgettable celebration.

title: Untitled Ocean's Prequel
overview: Follows Danny Ocean's parents, two masterminds, as they pull off an elaborate heist at the 1962 Monaco Grand Prix.

title: Michael: Part Two
overview: The sequel to the 2026 biopic. Plot TBA.

title: Michael: Part Two
overview: The journey of a global icon continues. Following his ascent to solo superstardom, Michael finds himself at the pinnacle of his influence, navigating a world where his every move is captured by the lens of history. As the boundaries between his private life and his public persona blur, he embarks on his most ambitious creative chapters yet, pushing the limits of artistry and innovation in an ever-changing landscape.

title: Beyond the Apex: Part III
overview: The final installment in the Mikal Springer saga, will he redeem himself in the world of motorsport?

title: Bloody Hell, Nana
overview: Max has a busy day of work ahead, but first, he needs to get his Nana, Margaret, to her Doctor's appointment on time. Unfortunately, she isn't in the mood for rushing around, forcing Max to suffer a series of hilarious excursions on the way to their destination.
